mission: I need a quadcopter drone for real estate photography and videography. It should carry a gimbal-stabilized camera weighing about 300g, fly for at least 25 minutes, have a range of 2km, and be easy to transport. I want smooth cinematic footage capability, good low-light performance support, and GPS features like orbit mode and follow-me. Operating primarily in urban/suburban areas in the USA. Budget around $1500.
